'''Marja Holecyová''' (born Mária Holecyová<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Černáková |first=Jana |title=Slovenskú fantasy ságu píše študentka matematiky z Nitry |url=https://mynitra.sme.sk/c/5496555/slovensku-fantasy-sagu-pise-studentka-matematiky-z-nitry.html |access-date=2022-10-06 |website=mynitra.sme.sk |language=sk}}</ref> 28 August 1988) is a [[Slovakia|Slovak]] mathematician and fantasy writer.

== Education ==
Holecyová was born in Nitra. She studied Mathematics at the [[Comenius University]]. Her PhD thesis ''Maximum Principle for Infinite Horizon Discrete Time Optimal Control Problems'' was supervised by professor [[Pavel Brunovský]] and defended in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Maximum Principle for Infnite Horizon Discrete Time Optimal Control Problems |url=http://www.iam.fmph.uniba.sk/studium/efm/phd/holecyova/ |access-date=2022-10-06 |website=www.iam.fmph.uniba.sk}}</ref>

== Writing ==
Holecyová started writing [[Harry Potter]] [[fan fiction]] as a 16 years old under the pseudonym Marja Holecyová. Encouraged by the popularity of her writing she send a manuscript of her own fantasy story set in [[Slovakia]] and based on local mythology Mariotovi dediči (Heirs of Mariot) to the Slovak branch of Czech fantasy and sci-fi published Fragment at the age of 20.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 March 2010 |title=Príbeh: Marja mala len šestnásť rokov, keď začala písať |url=https://zena.pravda.sk/vselico/clanok/268720-pribeh-marja-mala-len-sestnast-rokov-ked-zacala-pisat/ |access-date=2022-10-06 |website=Pravda.sk |language=sk-SK}}</ref> The success of the book resulted in three sequels published over the course of 2010 and 2011.<ref name=":0" /> In 2016, she published a [[historical fantasy]] novel set in the 16th century [[Kingdom of Hungary]] called Korene Hriechu (Roots of sin)<ref>{{Cite web |date=11 March 2019 |title=Marja Holecyová |url=https://www.litcentrum.sk/autor/marja-holecyova |access-date=2022-10-06 |website=Literárne informačné centrum |language=sk}}</ref>
